login.title: Sign in to lazyit
login.subtitle: You will be redirected to your organization's identity provider to authenticate.
login.localSubtitle: Enter your lazyit account email or username and password.
login.localHelper: Sign in with the lazyit account your administrator created for you.
login.ssoHelper: lazyit uses your organization's single sign-on (SSO). No separate password is needed.
login.firstTimeHint: First time signing in? Your initial password is temporary — you'll be asked to set your own.
login.unconfiguredTitle: This instance isn't set up yet
login.unconfiguredDetail: No administrator exists, so there is no one to sign in. Run the one-time setup to create the first administrator.

changePassword.panelDescription: Set a new password for your lazyit account. You'll stay signed in on this device; any other sessions will be signed out.
changePassword.sameAsCurrent: New password must differ from the current password.
changePassword.genericError: Couldn't change your password. Please try again.
changePassword.forcedSubtitle: Before you can continue, choose a password of your own.
changePassword.forcedIntro: Your current password was set for you and is temporary. Choose a new password to finish signing in — you won't be able to use lazyit until you do.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: We'll email you a link to set a new password.
forgotPassword.helper: Enter the email or username of your lazyit account.
forgotPassword.confirmation: If an account matches that email or username, we've sent it a link to reset the password. Check your inbox — the link expires shortly.
forgotPassword.genericError: Something went wrong sending the reset link. Please try again.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Set the new password for your lazyit account.
resetPassword.success: Your password has been reset. Sign in with your new password.
resetPassword.invalidTokenError: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one and try again.
resetPassword.invalidSubtitle: This page needs a valid reset link.
resetPassword.invalidDetail: The reset link is incomplete. Request a new one from the sign-in page.

errors.configurationDetail: lazyit could not reach its identity provider. Check the OIDC environment variables (issuer, client id and secret) and that the provider is running, then try again.
errors.accessDeniedDetail: Your identity provider declined the sign-in. Your account may not be permitted to access this lazyit instance — contact your administrator.
errors.verificationDetail: The sign-in request could not be verified or has expired. Start the sign-in again.
errors.defaultDetail: Something went wrong while signing you in. Please try again; if it keeps happening, contact your administrator.
